subject: Dinner after the flight cancellation
text:
Hi,

I am inviting you to dinner because the storm canceled my flight, and the delay has left me with an unusual evening. The support queue is under control, the project notes you sent are already loaded, and my replacement shift is handled. The airline rerouted me for tomorrow morning, so there is no reason to spend the night waiting at the hotel.

Would you join me at the quiet place near the station? It is not a work meeting, only an old friend grabbing food with you after all those late tickets. I can cover the first round, and we can talk about something other than deadlines if you prefer.

Reply by early evening if you want to come, and I will hold a small table.

Best,
Support agent
